title: One-host build budget safeguards
summary: Added host-side coordination for heavy builds and browser tests, with bounded Cargo parallelism and safer cleanup of tracked test processes.
details: A cooperative lease admits one heavy task on the host; Cargo defaults to two jobs, work already in progress can finish, and failures trigger a cooldown even when the commit changes.

Release-state persistence is atomic and fail-closed. Browser-test cleanup tracks descendant processes. A one-shot launchd handoff is staged to wait for the previous watcher to exit; the handoff is not yet active.
Stopped seven orphaned test-stack processes after confirming they had no active endpoint clients; active release and live services were preserved.

Host-only verification passed: 13 synthetic guard and release tests, 23 desktop release tests, 12 Android build tests, and 2 owned-process Node tests (50 tests total), plus Python compilation and Node syntax checks. The host admission probe deferred correctly under elevated memory pressure.
limitation: This is host tooling only, with no game logic changes or gameplay performance claim. Launchd storage preflight is still being validated, and the staged watcher handoff has not completed.
